visualBrief: Amber Fort’s sandstone palace above Maota Lake, with Jaleb Chowk, the public audience hall, Ganesh Pol, the Charbagh court, Sheesh Mahal and the Man Singh Mahal court.
limitations: The model reconstructs the upper fort and four principal palace courts within the mapped footprint. Maota Lake, Kesar Kyari, approach paths, dispersed hill walls and independent neighboring buildings use the host map.
The standard six-meter terrain grid smooths retaining-wall faces and the grade below the zigzag approaches. The authored court decks follow the stepped layout and retain the surrounding terrain.
The carved screens and painted ornament read at World Viewer scale. Tunnels and mirrored interiors are outside this exterior reconstruction.

photoFacing.frontBasis: The long PMTiles polygon axis follows the four ascending courts. The lake is east of the palace and Ganesh Pol opens onto the northern audience court.

terrain: Bilinear six-meter sampling from standard zoom-15 Terrarium tiles.
